reviewItem.question: Does "Cilium now supports services protocol differentiation, which allows the agent to distinguish two services on the same port with different protocols (e.g. TCP…" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--bpf-lb-proto-diff|component=cilium-agent (added)?

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.17 adds service protocol differentiation (enabled by default, controlled by --bpf-lb-proto-diff); existing services without a protocol are preserved and must be deleted and recreated for the protocol to be taken into account.
